capabilities.target: researcher sub-agent (can itself spawn further researchers)
CRM account record (industry, size, headquarters fields)

inputs.source: Nightly batch of CRM account rows (40,000 rows/night)

instructions.note: 'Keep going until every row is complete' sets no limit on retries, runtime, or spawn depth. Combined with the runtime note that ~3% of rows have malformed company names that never return a complete result, this guarantees the loop never terminates for those rows.

'retry, or spawn a researcher sub agent' leaves the choice, count, and depth of retries/spawns entirely to the model, with no stated ceiling, and sub agents can themselves spawn further researchers per the runtime notes.

elements.name: Shared enrichment API key and monthly quota

controls.name: Max unattended steps and runtime cap
controls.decay_rationale: An orchestrator-enforced step/runtime ceiling does not depend on the model choosing to stop.

controls.name: Per-row retry limit on enrich.lookup
controls.decay_rationale: A retry counter enforced outside the model stops the loop regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Sub-agent spawn depth and count limit
controls.decay_rationale: A hard cap on delegation depth/fan-out enforced by the spawning mechanism itself does not decay with model capability.

controls.name: Hard spend cap on enrichment API usage
controls.decay_rationale: A billing-side hard stop is enforced by the API provider/finance layer, not the model.

controls.name: Real-time spend alert on the enrichment account
controls.decay_rationale: Monitoring infrastructure independent of the model; currently absent per runtime notes.

controls.name: Dedicated API key/quota separate from sales and marketing
controls.decay_rationale: Isolating the credential and budget at the infrastructure/identity layer removes the shared blast radius regardless of model behavior.

findings.title: TC6 Spend loop / cascading failure: malformed CRM rows trigger unbounded retries and sub-agent spawning against a billed, shared-quota API

attack_path.note: Nightly batch of 40,000 rows; ~3% have malformed company names that never return a complete result
Billed per call; a failed/incomplete lookup triggers retry or spawn per prompt.md:2
Spawns a researcher sub-agent, which can itself spawn further researchers with no stated depth limit
Each spawned researcher again invokes the billed enrich.lookup call
All calls draw against the same monthly quota shared with sales and marketing tools

evidence.observation: Instructs the agent to retry or spawn a researcher sub-agent and 'keep going until every row is complete,' with no stated limit on retries or spawn depth.
'There is no maximum on steps, runtime, retries, or sub agents. Sub agents can spawn their own researchers.'
'enrich.lookup is billed per call. The API key and its monthly quota are shared with the sales and marketing teams; when the quota runs out, their tools stop working until the next month.'
'Roughly 3 percent of rows have malformed company names that never return a complete result,' which guarantees the 'until every row is complete' loop never terminates for those rows.
'There is no spend alert on the enrichment account.'

recommendations.action: Enforce a hard orchestrator-level cap on steps, runtime, retries per row, and sub-agent spawn depth/count; do not rely on the prompt to self-limit.
Give the enrichment agent a dedicated API key and quota separate from sales and marketing, or reserve a fixed sub-budget, so a runaway loop cannot take down other teams' tools.
Add a real-time spend alert and dashboard on the enrichment account's billing.
Revise the prompt to cap retries per row (e.g., 2) and route unresolved/malformed rows to a 'needs manual review' queue instead of looping indefinitely.

rating.rationale: The only finding (f1) reaches an S3 sink (spend via cap.enrich_lookup, and delegate via cap.spawn_researcher) from an internal source, with the A4/can_spawn_agents autonomy modifier applied once, giving inherent = critical. No declared or verified controls exist on this path (all recommended controls are status: missing_recommended), so no rubric section 5 credit applies and residual remains critical. Because the tier is already at the ceiling, no forecast trigger can raise it further; forecast = critical. The single most consequential missing control is the orchestrator-level step/runtime/retry/spawn cap (ctrl.step_runtime_limit and ctrl.retry_limit), since the 3% malformed-row rate makes the 'until complete' loop a near-certainty rather than a hypothetical, and the shared quota (store.shared_quota) turns a cost problem into a denial of service against sales and marketing.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design in prompt.md and the accompanying runtime notes, not observed runtime behavior or logs of actual nightly runs.

No tool manifest or MCP/API configuration was provided; the scope and authentication of cap.enrich_lookup and cap.spawn_researcher are inferred from prose, which lowers confidence on exact credential handling.

No information was given on what credentials or quota a spawned researcher sub-agent inherits; credential_scope for cap.spawn_researcher is assumed to mirror the shared service account used by cap.enrich_lookup.
No information was given on whether cap.crm_write ever receives partial or malformed enrichment data; this path was inventoried but not scored as a separate finding due to insufficient evidence.
